data_file.description: Path to a file containing raw packet data to be sent. If provided, payload_data is ignored.

modules.description: List of modules to load in order. Modules are nested headers inside previous ones.

payload_data.description: Raw data string to append to the packet. Supports 'rN' (random), '0x' (hex), '0' (octal). Ignored if data_file is set.

socket_options.description: Socket options string. Valid chars: 'b' (SO_BROADCAST), 'i' (IP_HDRINCL), '6' (IPV6_*). Leave empty for defaults.

target_host.description: Destination hostname or IP address for the packet.

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode to display packet details during construction and transmission.
